The '''Gunthar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taul/Legends|Taul]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Taul was the site of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] trading post/training base which was [[Battle of Taul|destroyed]] by the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Victory-class)|''Dominator'']].
